rationale: This is the independent implementation review of the narrow R45 repair that reconnects the existing scientific evidence producer to the partition-delivery consumer. The diff is exactly 6 files and matches the commit stat. The diagnosed defect is corroborated by the read-only probe: the R44 execution loader omitted the producer wrapper that appends 62 individually scanned supplemental descriptors to the 176 registered views (actual 238, delta_count 0, first 176 identical), and the old consumer required the index inline in the prompt while the current producer delivers navigation in one mandatory hash-bound artifact-index file (index_in_prompt false, views_equal false). The repair is equivalent-or-stronger, not a weakening: connect_evidence reuses the exact existing revision_evidence.append under a strict EVIDENCE_DELIVERY_SCOPE guard (root==driver.context, ref==config private_intake, stage in run_spec_author/review, idea_ids match), and delivered_navigation only governs HOW the index is navigationally presented (legacy inline OR one authenticated bound nav file with fixed key set, encoded-in-prompt, page_lines 1..100, confined path, exact sha/bytes/characters, exactly one encoded occurrence). The actual sealing in reviewed() is unchanged in strength: it still requires private_scientific_views==descriptors (all 238), the index JSON to equal {schema,registry_sha256,views:descriptors} with exact hash, and each selected/index descriptor to appear once with a matching hash; arbitrary supersets or skipped checks are rejected, and path traversal (../escape) fails. The admission authority is tightened consistently: the FILES set now includes experiment_partition_input.py so the installed-member and installed-source hash checks pin the newly changed file, and the installer chains PRIOR_UNIT to the genuine R44-installed unit (PRIOR_UNIT_SHA 828231643eaf equals the packet hash of PRIOR_UNIT.txt), rewriting only ExecStart and Description. record_for still hard-codes REVISE/findings_closed False/full_training_allowed False/coverage_allowed False, and the preserved scientific REVISE with U1/U2/U3 is intact. Install stays held and root-only, requiring genuine implementation APPROVE, genuine direction (report 7653, source 0def), operator binding and exact reviewed source hashes; activation remains a single CAS preserving the blocked state, all local/scientific call rows and open findings; the candidate replay is explicitly read-only (no ACTIVATION_INTENT, state_unchanged true) and reports 238 views, REVISE, findings_closed False. The disclosed first-run failures are pure test-fixture bugs (writes over read-only synthetic originals and a wrong-context fixture), corrected in the fixed test file with no gate-code change, consistent with the final 15-passed run. Budget guards are untouched (modal_item4_budget not in the changed set; $75/$1200/$1275 caps and the 35.348053 reservation within 75; no compute/model/provider launched). I found no test-set leakage (development-only membership, synthetic patient_data False fixtures, byte-exact seal), no code/spec mismatch (238=176+62 matches SPEC14; delivery check equivalent-or-stronger), no metric/statistic defect (no metric code changed; verdict/findings preserved), no privacy/secret exposure (no patient bytes or credentials; producer scans PASS), no budget relaxation, and no execution-authority/provenance gap (held install, chained unit, scope-guarded producer, read-only replay). Accordingly findings is empty and the verdict is APPROVE; the preserved scientific REVISE and its U1/U2/U3 blockers are not findings against this implementation and must not be conflated with it.
